input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a smiling office worker in a mustard-yellow sweater sits at a light blue desk with a monitor. A stack of mixed paper documents floats beside them: an invoice, a purchase order, a slightly tilted scanned lease, and a phone photo of a bank statement, all drawn as simple white pages with only abstract pale blue placeholder lines and blocks and one small stamp accent, the pages are blank of any lettering. In the center, a friendly rounded document-scanner device in white and periwinkle blue with a glowing scanning beam reads the documents. From the scanner, neat rows of structured data (small white cards with pale blue bars, blue check marks and a small table grid) flow along a soft dotted path to the right into a large ERP dashboard screen with a simple bar chart and ledger rows. A small yellow lightbulb with sparkles and a pale yellow gear sit in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob shape on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds and a couple of thin outlined globe icons. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, lots of clean white space around the blob, Strictly no text, no words, no letters, no labels, no titles anywhere in the image; every document, card and screen shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
